answer: Because the timing is recorded against the spiral challenge, the nectar audit can replay the sonnet history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm as a result has to pad 33 submissions and hold each account open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 4812 identities would post 4467 proofs and burn roughly 16 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
